_rule: Prepared BEFORE the run (AGENTS.md). STAGED, not queued, not authorized. One Water Queens House (S8) launch, the user's set (release Ultra, fg=3, the RTX Hair bundle, rr_hair_strand_aa=2), camera zoomed in 20 wheel notches (hf1 073932 with 10: heads about 30 px in the half-resolution captures) and then static. Five watch windows of 8 s, each fg=3 one starting only after a fresh '[sl] DLSS-G frame' line with displayed/rendered >= 2.5 (runner wait condition, 30 s, then 'pipeline readiness timed out: <label>; missing: ...'), each followed by 4 s with 12 presented frames captured (fg_snap, rendered and generated frames in present order): A fg=3 strands, B fg=0 strands, C fg=3 strands again, D fg=3 with rr_hair_strand_aa=0, E fg=3 with cards (rt_hair_groom_primary=0). fg is toggled live (layer/streamline.cpp reads it every present; the game starts with fg=3, so Streamline is loaded; precedent ef1 'fg-off').
observable: In which window does the fast on/off toggling of the heads (user eyewitness, hs1 and earlier lives) stop? The user watches the windows; the presented captures give the same answer as a number.
number: hair region flicker of the presented frames: mean absolute difference between consecutive pNN.png in the head region, split by frame kind (at fg=3 the present order is one rendered frame and two generated ones; kind = index mod 3 once the phase is found from the lowest-difference grouping). Noise = the same number in window C against window A (same settings, two captures).

frame generation.predicted: A and C: generated frames differ from their rendered neighbours in the head region by >= 2x the rendered-to-rendered difference (the strand pixels' depth and motion vectors given to FG switch between strand and background with the jitter each rendered frame: shaders/rt/hair_primary_gbuffer.hlsl SV_Depth, hair_primary_velocity.hlsl discard), B: no generated frames, head difference at the rendered-to-rendered level, and the user sees the toggling stop in B and come back in C
frame generation.decides_fg_if: the user reports B stable and A, C toggling, and the generated-to-rendered difference in A and C is outside the A against C spread
frame generation.next_if_fg: stable FG inputs on hair: the card depth and card motion vector for FG at strand pixels (the hold layer, rt_hair_primary_hold), or the strand depth dilated over the card region, behind a key; then this job again

strand coverage or reconstruction.predicted_if_not_fg: the toggling persists in B (no generated frames) and stops only in E (cards)
strand coverage or reconstruction.next: then it is in the rendered image after all: compare hs1's final bursts at full resolution in the head region (the 1.02 ratio was a mean over all hair pixels)

strand aa.predicted: D against C: no change the user can see (hs1: rr_color flicker within the half spread)
strand aa.decides_aa_if: the toggling stops in D and returns in a later strands window with rr_hair_strand_aa=2

cards.predicted: E: stable heads (the user's reference for 'no toggling')
cards.note: if E also toggles, the cause is not RTX Hair: report and stop

invalid_if: no '[sl] FG decision ... want 0 requested 0; reason requested-off' in window B, or no return to 'want 3 requested 3' in window C
a snap window without '[sl] presented frame 11 -> ... (ok)' (the last PNG; 'present capture done' is logged 0.1 s after the request and fell before the window start in hf1 073932)

an fg=3 watch window that starts without its wait condition (runner: 'pipeline readiness timed out: survive-fg3-...': the generated frames were not shown within 30 s of the fg change). hf1 073932: 3.00 came 2.7 s after the live fg 0 -> 3; only the first enable after the load took 13 s on the layer's present counter (SDK cadence 3.00 after 2 s)
no '[hair primary] frame N: RTX Hair off (live)' in window E
cost: none measured: no new code path; report the '[rrpost] gpu: render-res chain' line only
disk: 5 captures x 12 PNG at the presented size, about 0.3 GB; kept until the comparison is done, then deleted
